senses.gloss:
अर्य अर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ऋ), attached to,
true, devoted, dear; kind; excellent; (अस्), m. a master,
lord; an Āryan; a man of the third tribe, a Vaiśya;
(आ), f. a woman of the third tribe, the wife of a
Vaiśya.
—अर्य-जारा, f., Ved. the mistress of an Ār-
yan.
—अर्य-पत्नी, f., Ved. wife of a true, legitimate
husband.
—अर्य-वर्य, अस्, m. a Vaiśya of rank.
—अर्य-श्वेत, अस्, m., N. of a man.

आर्य आर्य, अस्, आ, m. f. (fr. अर्य, rt. ऋ), a
loyal or faithful man, a man of one's own race; one
who is faithful to the deities of his country; N. of
the Hindū and Iranian people (opposed to अन्-आर्य,
दस्यु, दास); in later times N. of the first three
castes (opposed to शूद्र); a man highly esteemed,
a respectable, honourable man; a master, an owner; a
friend; a Vaiśya; Buddha; (with Buddhists) a man who
has thought on the four chief principles of Buddhism
and lives according to them; a son of Manu Sāvarṇa;
[]
(अस्, आ, or ई, अम्), Āryan, favourable to the Āryan
people; behaving like an Āryan, worthy of one,
honourable, respectable, noble; of a good family;
excellent; wise; suitable; (आ), f. a name of Pārvatī;
a kind of metre of two lines, each, line consisting of
seven and a half feet; each foot containing four in-
stants, except the sixth of the second line, which con-
tains only one, and is therefore a single short syllable;
hence there are thirty instants in the first line and
twenty-seven in the second; [with आर्य cf. the Old
Germ. êra and Mod. Germ. Ehre.]
—आर्य-गृह्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, easily to be got by honourable men, to
be received with honour by noble men; decorous,
respectable, right.
—आर्य-ता, f. or आर्य-त्व, अम्, n.
honourable behaviour.
—आर्य-देव, अस्, m., N. of a
pupil of Nāgārjuna.
—आर्य-देश, अस्, m. a region
inhabited by Āryans or followers of the Āryan laws.
—आर्यदेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, originating from such a
region.
—आर्य-पुत्र, अस्, m. son of an Āryan or
honourable man; the son of a spiritual preceptor;
honorific designation of the son of an elder brother;
of a husband by his wife; of a prince by a general;
a husband (in theatrical language).
—आर्य-प्राय,
अस्, आ, अम्, inhabited by Āryan people; abound-
ing with respectable persons.
—आर्य-भट्ट, अस्,
m., N. of a renowned astronomer, the inventor of
algebra, among the Hindūs.
—आर्य-भाव, अस्,
m. honourable character or behaviour.
—आर्य-
मार्ग, अस्, m. the way of the honourable, the
respectable way.
—आर्य-मिश्र, आस्, m. pl. an as-
sembly of respectable or honourable men; (अस्, आ,
अम्), distinguished, respectable; (अस्), m. a gentleman,
a man of consequence.
—आर्य-युवन्, आ, m. an Āryan
youth.
—आर्य-राज, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—आर्य-
रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has only the form of an
Āryan; a hypocrite, an impostor.
—आर्यलिङ्गिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, one who bears the external semblance of an Āryan
or honourable man, an impostor.
—आर्य-वर्मन्, आ,
m., N. of a king.
—आर्य-वृत्त, अम्, n. the behaviour
of an Āryan or noble man; (अस्, आ, अम्), behaving
like an Āryan; virtuous, good, pious.
—आर्य-वेश,
अस्, आ, अम्, dressed like an Āryan, well clothed, fine.
—आर्य-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who observes the
laws and ordinances of the Āryans or honourable men.
—आर्य-सङ्घ, अस्, m. the whole body of the
Āryans, the collective body of noblemen; N. of a
renowned philosopher, founder of the school of the
Yogākāras.
—आर्य-सत्य, अम्, n. a noble or sublime
truth; four such truths form the four chief principles
of Buddhism.
—आर्य-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist
patriarch.
—आर्य-हृद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, beloved by the
noble.
—आर्या-गीति, इस्, f. a variety of the Āryā metre,
containing eight equal feet or thirty-two syllabic in-
stants in each verse of the couplet.
—आर्यावर्त (˚य-
आव्˚), अस्, m. abode of the noble or excellent; the
sacred land or place of residence of the Āryans; N.
of the land extending from the eastern to the western
sea, and bounded on the north and south by the
Himālaya and Vindhya mountains.
—आर्या-विलास,
अस्, m. title of a work.
—आर्याष्टशत (˚य-अष्ट-
श˚), अम्, n. title of a work of Ārya-bhaṭṭa's, consisting
of eight hundred distichs.

अर्यमन्, आ, m., Ved. a bosom friend, play-fellow,
companion, especially a friend who asks a woman in
marriage for another; N. of an Āditya, who is com-
monly invoked together with Varuṇa and Mitra; N.
of the chief of the manes; the sun; the Asclepias
plant.
—अर्यम-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—अर्यम-देवा, f., N. of the twelfth lunar mansion.

अर्यम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. intimate, very friendly;
(अस्), m. bosom friend, companion.

अर्ययाणी, f. a multitude of women of the Vaiśya
tribe (?).

अर्याणी, f. a mistress; a woman of the third or
Vaiśya tribe.

आर्यक, अस्, m. an honourable, respectable man; a
grandfather; N. of a cowherd who became king; of
a Nāga.
—आर्यका or आर्यिका, f. a respectable woman;
(इका), f., N. of a Nakṣatra; (अकम्), n. a ceremony
performed to the manes, the vessel &c. used in sacri-
fices made to the manes.
